Topic 2.1.9: The school

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The school
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ The school

Teach
• Observe The school in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about The school (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to The school.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for The school.
• Write 5 bullet facts about The school.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on The school.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for The school: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify members of the (Head teacher, teachers, non-teaching 2. What is the importance school community staff and learners) of the school

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
